findings.text: the fallback reports service_active False although that state was never measured on the path that raised at reckon/crew/runs.py:2247, and on the path where the unit was started and a later call failed my independent probe returned path "fallback" with manager_starts [True] and service_active false, so a caller reading the field is told the service is down when this very call started it.

the section record lists the classifier's markers as "failed to connect to bus, connection refused, the removed socket, and the launcher's is not available on this host" while the tuple at reckon/crew/runs.py:2176-2182 carries five different ones, two of which ("connection reset by peer", "transport endpoint is not connected") the record does not name, so a reader reasoning about the classifier from the record will expect a bare removed-socket message to fall back when only the "failed to connect to bus" prefix makes it.

the recorded Verification conditions do not reproduce the recorded result: with the root environment's interpreter, the worktree on PYTHONPATH and no environment bin on PATH, the named file reports 4 failed, 1 passed, because render_watch_unit resolves the reckon console script through _watcher_executable at reckon/crew/runs.py:2019; the manifest's own tests line carries the missing PATH prefix, so the two records disagree about the same gate.
